answer: How do you stop a rack of bots from minting seats? Make each seat prove a federal bird-banding permit. Before rewards unlock, the agent files a ZK proof of one unique permit ID that authorizes banding sparrows in the field. Permits name a single holder and take months to get, so a thousand ghosts collapse onto one number. Example: twenty clones paste the same banding-anchor card and share one pigment of standing; twenty licensed banders with twenty IDs unlock twenty seats.
